plan.title: SRC-LOT-007 Reopen Line After Submission Ends

steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen for the auction event.
Enable the required configuration for reopening staggered auction line items.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Create multiple line items so the event has lines that could be reopened.
Complete the pricing sheet before publishing.
Commit a submission window that can be ended before the reopen attempt.
Publish the event so its submission window is active.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
End the event so the whole submission time is over before attempting to reopen a line.
Open the stage action for reopening expired line items.

args.goal: Attempt to select a line item and submit the Reopen Line Items action on the buyer screen after the event submission time has ended; stop when the refusal is shown.

steps.note: Perform the line-item reopen attempt that has no dedicated catalog action.
